disruption-quantum-analysis-skill.name: Disruption & Loss/Expense Quantum Analysis
disruption-quantum-analysis-skill.description: Quantifying construction disruption using Measured Mile analysis, baseline comparison, unabsorbed head-office overheads (Hudson/Emden/Eichleay formulas).

claims-preparation-defense-skill.name: Construction Claims Preparation & Defense
claims-preparation-defense-skill.description: Drafting comprehensive claim narratives detailing contractual entitlement, causal nexus, delay substantiation, and defending claims against client counterclaims.

construction-risk-assessment-skill.name: Construction Risk Assessment & Register Management
construction-risk-assessment-skill.description: Facilitating multi-disciplinary risk workshops, formulating risk breakdown structures, qualitative risk matrices, and developing action mitigation plans.

monte-carlo-schedule-cost-risk-skill.name: Monte Carlo Schedule & Cost Risk Simulation
monte-carlo-schedule-cost-risk-skill.description: Applying 3-point duration/cost probability distributions (Beta, Triangular), running Monte Carlo iterations, and determining P80 project contingency reserves.

risk-register-mitigation-planning-skill.name: Risk Register Tracking & Mitigation Planning
risk-register-mitigation-planning-skill.description: Maintaining living project risk registers, tracking risk trigger events, residual risk scoring, and assigning clear risk ownership across project teams.

itp-preparation-execution-skill.name: Inspection & Test Plan (ITP) Preparation & Execution
itp-preparation-execution-skill.description: Defining hold, witness, and review points for civil works, aligning testing frequencies with technical specifications, and managing inspection sign-offs.

ncr-investigation-corrective-action-skil.name: Non-Conformance Reporting (NCR) & Root Cause Analysis
ncr-investigation-corrective-action-skil.description: Issuing site NCRs, conducting 5-Why and Ishikawa root cause investigations, reviewing structural repair methodologies, and closing out corrective actions.

job-safety-analysis-jsa-skill.name: Job Safety Analysis (JSA) & Safe Work Method Statements
job-safety-analysis-jsa-skill.description: Breaking down site activities into sequence steps, identifying hazardous conditions, and prescribing mandatory PPE, safety controls, and toolbox talks.

permit-to-work-ptw-management-skill.name: Permit-to-Work (PTW) Site Safety Protocols
permit-to-work-ptw-management-skill.description: Managing strict authorization and safety isolation permits for hot work, deep excavation entry, confined spaces, heavy lifting, and night operations.

temporary-works-engineering-skill.name: Temporary Works Design & Procedural Management
temporary-works-engineering-skill.description: Designing and checking shoring systems, cofferdams, working platforms, falsework towers, and enforcing BS 5975 temporary works coordinator procedures.

formwork-falsework-design-skill.name: Formwork & Falsework Structural Design
formwork-falsework-design-skill.description: Calculating timber/steel waler bending moments, tie-rod tensile forces, concrete rate-of-pour limits, and modular aluminum formwork cycles.

lifting-rigging-planning-skill.name: Heavy Lifting & Crane Rigging Planning
lifting-rigging-planning-skill.description: Designing tandem crane lift geometries, calculating crane ground bearing pressures, selecting spreader bars, slings, and rigging gear configurations.

equipment-selection-fleet-sizing-skill.name: Heavy Machinery Selection & Fleet Sizing
equipment-selection-fleet-sizing-skill.description: Matching earthmoving loader capacities to hauler truck fleets, calculating required fleet numbers based on mass-haul balances, and equipment sizing.

machinery-cycle-time-analysis-skill.name: Machinery Cycle Time & Production Analysis
machinery-cycle-time-analysis-skill.description: Measuring loading, hauling, dumping, and return cycle times to calculate realistic hourly production volumes (m3/hr) and hourly fleet costs.

daily-site-reporting-inspection-skill.name: Daily Site Diary & Inspection Management
daily-site-reporting-inspection-skill.description: Maintaining detailed site records of workforce headcount, weather impacts, equipment downtime, ongoing activities, and managing site inspection requests.

construction-logistics-planning-skill.name: Site Logistics & Master Staging Planning
construction-logistics-planning-skill.description: Creating site layout mobilization drawings, material delivery holding zones, gate access scheduling, and on-site internal traffic flow management.

material-demand-forecasting-inventory-sk.name: Material Demand Forecasting & Inventory Control
material-demand-forecasting-inventory-sk.description: Converting 3-week lookahead schedules into material procurement call-offs, tracking warehouse buffer stock, and avoiding site material shortages.

site-laydown-traffic-management-skill.name: Site Laydown & Traffic Management
site-laydown-traffic-management-skill.description: Designing secure material storage yards, hazardous chemical storage protocols, heavy vehicle turning radiuses, and pedestrian-plant segregation.

superstructure-construction-execution-sk.name: Building Superstructure Construction Execution
superstructure-construction-execution-sk.description: Directing multi-story concrete pour cycles, rebar placement supervision, post-tensioning stressing, and structural steel framing assembly.

mep-clash-coordination-supervision-skill.name: MEP Services Clash Coordination & Field Supervision
mep-clash-coordination-supervision-skill.description: Coordinating builder work sleeves, MEP pipe/duct penetrations, vertical riser installation, and electrical distribution board rough-ins on site.

building-envelope-facade-inspection-skil.name: Building Envelope & Façade Quality Inspection
building-envelope-facade-inspection-skil.description: Supervising unitized curtain wall erection, exterior waterproofing membrane installation, window water penetration testing, and thermal insulation QA.

infrastructure-construction-planning-ski.name: Infrastructure Construction Planning & Execution
infrastructure-construction-planning-ski.description: Developing phase staging for linear roadworks, bridge superstructure launching, culvert installations, utility diversions, and public traffic diversions.

heavy-civil-site-execution-skill.name: Heavy Civil Works Site Execution
heavy-civil-site-execution-skill.description: Executing major earthworks, rock blasting, deep foundation diaphragm walls, segmental bridge launching, and marine piling operations.

linear-project-construction-management-s.name: Linear Project Scheduling & Location-Based Management
linear-project-construction-management-s.description: Applying Time-Chainage diagrams and Line of Balance (LOB) techniques to highway paving, pipeline trenching, and railway track laying progress.

physical-progress-measurement-skill.name: Physical Progress Measurement & Rules of Credit
physical-progress-measurement-skill.description: Establishing weighted physical progress milestones, auditing contractor progress claims against installed quantities, and updating progress S-curves.

project-kpi-dashboard-analytics-skill.name: Project KPI Dashboard Design & Analytics
project-kpi-dashboard-analytics-skill.description: Building automated visual dashboards in Power BI/Excel displaying schedule variance, cost overrun risks, safety incident rates, and productivity trends.

construction-trend-forecasting-skill.name: Construction Trend Forecasting & Early Warning
construction-trend-forecasting-skill.description: Extrapolating historical burn rates, predicting project completion dates, and establishing proactive early warning indicators for management intervention.

sustainable-construction-management-skil.name: Sustainable Construction Operations & Compliance
sustainable-construction-management-skil.description: Executing construction environmental management plans (CEMP), dust suppression, stormwater sediment basins, low-VOC tracking, and eco-auditing.

construction-waste-diversion-skill.name: Construction Waste Diversion & Recycling Management
construction-waste-diversion-skill.description: Setting up on-site material sorting stations, partnering with certified recycling facilities, and tracking waste diversion percentages from landfills.

embodied-carbon-tracking-construction-sk.name: Embodied Carbon Tracking during Construction
embodied-carbon-tracking-construction-sk.description: Quantifying carbon emissions from fuel burned by site plant, transport logistics, and specifying low-carbon cementitious concrete mix designs (GGBS/PFA).

design-build-epc-management-skill.name: Design-Build & EPC Project Management
design-build-epc-management-skill.description: Managing single-point responsibility delivery, integrating design engineering with procurement and site construction, and value engineering.

modular-prefabrication-planning-skill.name: Modular & Off-Site Prefabrication Planning
modular-prefabrication-planning-skill.description: Planning factory manufacturing schedules, transport dimensional permits, and heavy crane erection sequences for volumetric modular building units.

vdc-model-based-coordination-skill.name: VDC Model-Based Field Coordination
vdc-model-based-coordination-skill.description: Conducting 3D multidisciplinary coordination meetings, managing clash matrixes, and pushing resolved federated models to field tablet devices.

cde-digital-site-management-skill.name: Common Data Environment (CDE) & Digital Site Records
cde-digital-site-management-skill.description: Administering ISO 19650 workflows within Autodesk Construction Cloud/Aconex, managing drawing revisions, field RFIs, and digital punch lists.
